title: Jeweled Umami Chinese Pork Hot Pot
description: A rich and indulgent Chinese dish featuring massaman curry paste and infused oil, served in a hot pot vessel, this Whole30-friendly recipe is perfect for a special occasion, with a depth of umami flavor and a glassy-jelly texture.

ingredients.name: infused oil
ingredients.notes: such as chili oil or sesame oil

instructions: Heat the infused oil in the hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the massaman curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add the pork belly and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the coconut aminos, fish sauce, and rice vinegar, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes.
Add the swiss chard stems and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the shiitake mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the swiss chard leaves and cook, stirring constantly, until wilted, about 1 minute.
Stir in the green onions and sesame seeds.
Serve the hot pot immediately, with additional infused oil and sesame seeds on the side if desired.
